description_en: Updates the status of the monitoring configuration of a Prometheus instance
description_zh: 更新Prometheus实例监控配置状态
kebab_example: aliyun arms update-prometheus-monitoring-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --monitoring-name customJob1 --type customJob --status run --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePrometheusMonitoringStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Prometheus instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the monitoring configuration
parameters.name: monitoring_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the monitoring configuration. 
Valid values for a Prometheus instance for Container Service: serviceMonitor, podMonitor, and customJob. 
Valid value for a Prometheus instance for ECS: customJob. 
The status of probe cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh:
容器服务类型的实例支持：serviceMonitor、podMonitor、customJob。
ecs类型的实例支持：customJob。
不支持probe的状态修改
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The status of the monitoring configuration. Valid values: run and stop. The status of Probe cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh:
监控配置状态：run, stop。
probe暂不支持状态设置
parameters.name: status
